snippet.title: Not a Crow - Exclusive Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase
snippet.description:
Definitely not a crow. Nothing suspicious here! Discover Not a Crow in this exclusive trailer from the Cozy After Dark Showcase.

Cozy After Dark Steam Event:
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45664741/sale/TheCozyAfterDarkShowcase

Cozy After Dark Merch x The Yetee:
https://theyetee.com/collections/cozy-after-dark

Check out the Cozy After Dark Humble Bundle:
https://www.humblebundle.com/games/cozy-after-dark-showcase-bundle?view=xX5TjoERVuef 


Cozy After Dark celebrates games that live somewhere between comforting and unsettling. From dark fantasy and supernatural mysteries to strange adventures, eerie puzzles, horror, strategy, and cozy sims with something lurking just beneath the surface.

Featuring **50+ exclusive trailers and developer spotlights**, plus even more games to discover throughout our Cozy After Dark Steam Event.

Hosted by **Mackenzie and Baron**, with special guest hosts **AyChristene, Eleni, Matt, Midas, Scott, and Kalesdad**.

Cozy After Dark is presented by nonprofit **Dames 4 Games**, in partnership with **Draknek & Friends** and **CONTINUE**!

Thank you to all of the developers, publishers, partners, creators, and community members who helped make our first Cozy After Dark possible.

**Find a game you love? Wishlist it, follow the developers, and let us know which games caught your eye in the comments!**



#CozyAfterDark #IndieGames #CozyGames #HorrorGames #GamingShowcase
